name: Modelize
summary: Shopify app that generates on-model, lifestyle, studio and flat-lay product photos in bulk from your existing catalogue images, using Google's Gemini image models.
best_for: Shopify fashion, jewellery and homeware sellers who need consistent on-model, lifestyle or flat-lay imagery across a large catalogue and cannot justify a photographer per drop
skip_if: you need art direction a preset cannot express, photography of the actual physical item in its real texture, or a vendor with a long public track record — this app launched in April 2026
honest_knock: The economics are flat: at roughly $0.19 to $0.20 an image on every tier, moving up the ladder buys resolution, custom presets and support, never a cheaper image. Read it that way and the pricing is honest; read it as a volume discount and you will overbuy. Two other things deserve a clear head. The output quality rides on Google's Gemini image models rather than on anything Modelize owns, so results and consistency can shift when Google ships a new version, and that is outside the vendor's control as much as yours. And the app is genuinely new — launched 20 April 2026, 26 reviews on 4 October 2026 — so the 4.9 average is a small sample, not a track record. Finally, an on-model photo generated by AI shows a person who does not exist; check what your ad platforms and marketplaces require you to disclose before you build a catalogue on it.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-09-17 and again on 2026-10-04 on apps.shopify.com/modelize, listed as “Modelize: AI Product Photos”) Free plan available, then Starter $19, Pro $49 and Enterprise $99 a month — the three paid rates are unchanged since 19 August 2026. The free tier was raised from 3 to 10 AI images, still one-time rather than per month, with built-in presets and models at standard 2K. Starter covers 100 images a month with 3 AI custom presets and 3 custom models, standard 2K and email support. Pro at $49 covers 250 images, 10 custom presets and 10 custom models, resolution up to 4K and priority support. Enterprise at $99 includes 500 images with $0.20 per additional image, unlimited custom presets and models, maximum 4K and dedicated support. The annual option is gone: on modelize.studio/pricing, read the same day and again on 4 October 2026, all three paid tiers are labelled “Billed month to month” and the page carries no yearly rate and no two-months-free wording anywhere, where in August it sold Free, Starter and Pro annually. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Rating 4.9 from 26 App Store reviews on 4 October 2026 (25 at five stars, one at three), against 25 reviews on 17 September and 5.0 from 13 reviews on 19 August. Developer Optify, 16 Rue Cuvier, Lyon, France; the app launched 20 April 2026 and carries Shopify’s “Built for Shopify” badge.
